messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

These side effects were mostly stomach and bowel effects.
Examples included constipation.
Kidney function tends to decline with age.
Declining kidney function affects how tramadol is cleared.
Your doctor may take kidney function into account when choosing your dose.

The relation 'has effect on clearance' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug's clearance in the body is influenced by the factor specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has breakdown product': The subject drug is metabolized into the substance specified by the object entity.
B. 'has pharmacokinetic property': The subject drug exhibits the pharmacokinetic characteristic specified by the object entity.
C. 'alters absorption of': The subject drug changes the way the object entity is absorbed in the body.
D. 'cost varies based on': The subject drug's cost is influenced by the factor specified by the object entity.
E. 'has clearance delay in': The subject drug's clearance from the body is prolonged in patients with the condition specified by the object entity.
